summary: Standards: L1.check-order judges each pair against the answer of its earlier fault run alone, but only the pair's call is observed (c.own(run.call)); the reference run the verdict rests on is named in the finding message only when the check fails, so a passing report shows the pairs without the answers they were compared with. Also plan_paging_1_2 returns early when the next argv does not parse in the command document, so a command whose next entry the checker cannot read has its 1.2 half skipped with no note and no unsupported part. Blast radius: the report's observed list under-reports invocations the check ran (alone runs), and a silent skip is indistinguishable from a pass.
